scope: Original-copy observation requires actual draw/reveal events, own known zones or explicit RevealedTo entitlement; library mapping alone is not observation.
Tron access requires real hand/battlefield access; full Tron uses projected controlled land identities.
Loop readiness requires accepted sacrifice, another-Retriever return, two-mana cast, entry and restored hand/mana/untapped-permanent resources in the same turn. Inventory alone is insufficient.
Artifact recursion records a graveyard-to-hand return followed by the same copy being cast.
Actual lethal requires the engine terminal state, the acting player as winner and opponent life at most zero.

fixtures.replay_scope: Replay of the same accepted transition transcript into the observer, not a second full engine initialization; fixture-minted card IDs are not claimed deterministic.

limitations: This component deliberately cannot produce all four complete decision-rule metric flags.
Checkpoint total/color mana classification, caps/status handling, qualified future Foundry conversion certificates and complete runner replay remain separate gates.
Original-copy mapping is trusted only after the separately verified initializer/runtime binding; synthetic fixture mapping does not bind a sampled deck.
Source continuity and accepted-result checks do not replace durable action/event provenance, artifact contracts or exclusive attempt authorization.
The canonical priority-rule repair requires separate qualification before official R1 readiness.

independent_source_review.scope: Current ordering-fixture, actual collection-shaped tutor dispatch and eight event-metric fixture delta reviewed. Projected name falls back to printed identity when no name effect exists. No complete R1 permission or runtime acceptance is asserted.
